label: Дорога
description: A 10-sentence usage card for дорога with routes, surfaces, and travel logic.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject with adjective agreement. 'Длинная дорога' is the subject in the nominative case; the feminine adjective 'длинная' agrees with feminine 'дорога'. The verb 'ждёт' governs the accusative object 'нас'.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject with directional phrase. 'Дорога' is the nominative subject; 'в город' (accusative) names the destination the road leads to. The past-tense predicate 'была закрыта' agrees with the feminine subject.

missions.phrase: По дороге домой я купил хлеб.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case in a route frame. 'По дороге' uses the dative-governing preposition 'по' to mean 'on the way'; 'домой' gives direction. This is one of the most reusable travel patterns in Russian.

Strategic focus: Prepositional case of location. 'На дороге' uses 'на' + prepositional to mark physical location on a surface. The subject 'машина' is nominative, and 'стояла' agrees with it in feminine past tense.
Strategic focus: Genitive case marking proximity. 'У дороги' uses 'у' + genitive to mean 'beside the road'. The nominative subject 'дерево' is neuter, so the verb 'росло' takes the neuter past form.

Strategic focus: Accusative case of crossing. 'Через дорогу' uses 'через' + accusative to express crossing or spanning. The road is the path crossed; 'мост' is the accusative object of the impersonal verb 'построили'.
Strategic focus: Genitive case of removal. 'С дороги' uses 'с' + genitive to mark a source or surface something is taken off. 'Снег' is the accusative object that the subject 'рабочие' clears away.
Strategic focus: Genitive case of linear extent. 'Вдоль дороги' uses 'вдоль' + genitive to mean 'along the road'. The nominative plural subject 'дома' triggers the plural past verb 'стояли'.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject with directional verb. 'Дорога' is the nominative subject; 'ведёт' governs 'к станции' in the dative to express movement toward a goal. A practical pattern for giving directions.

missions.phrase: На этой дороге всегда очень тихо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case with demonstrative. 'На этой дороге' uses 'на' + prepositional; 'этой' agrees with feminine 'дороге'. The impersonal predicate 'тихо' describes the setting rather than a subject.
